coverage.result: A supplied Meteor 1.21.11 fixture and Spectator Xray resource-pack fixture were copied into an isolated temporary JUnit directory, metadata-validated, and classified as low-confidence CLIENT_REPORTED/OBSERVE.
coverage.not_proven: This is a static fixture regression, not a real Fabric client launch or cheat efficacy measurement.

coverage.result: Known fixture metadata is reported as low-confidence CLIENT_REPORTED/OBSERVE; malformed or oversized metadata becomes neutral unknown; an ungranted scope is rejected.
coverage.not_proven: A mod identifier or public utility-client identity is not a cheat verdict and has no automatic enforcement.

coverage.result: Policy-scoped integrity collection and bounded scanner behavior pass, including tamper and scope-boundary rejection.
End-to-end fixtures reject tamper, reorder, replay, expiry, and disconnect cases without creating a risk event.
Behavior flags require the configured threshold and window; cooldown suppresses duplicate emissions; independent providers are marked corroborated only when both qualify; bounded state removal works.
Supported accessor and compatibility contracts pass without loading a licensed artifact.
The gate refuses to claim runtime coverage when the explicitly supplied licensed artifact is absent.

false_positive_and_action_boundary.behavior_alerts: SERVER_CONFIRMED observation pipeline only; policy/review still controls action

limitations: No real cheat binary was launched; the supplied Meteor JAR and Xray pack were inspected only as isolated fixtures.
No injection, memory tool, packet exploit, or bypass implementation was executed.
No genuine licensed Vulcan event was delivered; the licensed runtime gate remains pending.
These tests establish defensive invariants and correlation behavior, not production precision/recall or a field false-positive rate.
A real SERVER_CONFIRMED production provider/profile/key/topology/producer remains a separate release gate.
